metadata.title: [Model][MRV2][DeepSeek-V4.1] DeepSeek-V4.1 and its DSpark drafter on Model Runner V2
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

**Depends on #1370, #1375, #1377 and #1221.** This branch is #1370 (two commits), #1375 (one), #1377 (one), then the three commits of #1221 by `Peuqui` (the MRV2 DSpark speculator and its compressed-index context buckets, included unchanged with their author), then one commit. Review only the last commit, "DeepSeek-V4.1 and its DSpark drafter on Model Runner V2". If #1221 lands first, its three commits drop out of this diff.

## Purpose

Runs the #1277 DeepSeek-V4.1 package under Model Runner V2 (`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, default off), with the V4.1 DSpark drafter on MRV2's speculator of #1221.

- **`model_states/deepseek_v41.py`: a V4.1 model state.** V4.1 keeps private per-sequence state (the Engram hash history and the ratio-2 compressor states). The V1 runner commits it after every forward; this state does the same through the MRV2 hooks: the prefill flag through `prepare_attn`, prefix restore on `add_request` (`model.restore_prefix`, on every PP stage, as V1's `_update_states` does), the sampled-count commit in `postprocess_state` (`model.commit_speculative_state`; on a first PP stage, #1370's "sampled counts arrived" path of `pp_commit.StageCommit`), and the coupled-draft keys and host temperatures of #1375.
- **`spec_decode/dspark/v41.py`: the V4.1 DSpark speculator.** The V4.1 drafter owns its CUDA graphs (query, context buckets, greedy and coupled draft graphs), so the runner-level draft graph is off for it. Draft sampling follows V1's order (greedy graph, coupled shard graph of #1377, fused coupled kernels, keyed loop, then MRV2's loop), and coupled-draft verification uses keyed target samples, which is exact. Each fallback logs its reason once.
- **`model_runner.py`:** `pp_before_forward` / `pp_after_forward` hooks on a first PP stage that is not the last, the target graph query length, and a prefill-skip context around each runtime forward. The prefill-skip context is inert here: it binds only when the model carries #1376's skip rows, so with #1376 merged MRV2 gets the same skip.
- **`input_batch.py`: `DummyPositions.CHAIN`.** Dummy, profile and capture batches carry positions 0..n-1, as the V1 runner's dummy run does. V4.1's Engram hash traps on positions that are not one token chain, and with MRV2's zeroed dummy positions every first-stage worker died in the first capture warmup ("unspecified launch failure"). Other models keep `ZEROS`.

Scheduling stays synchronous for V4.1 under MRV2. One behaviour differs from V1: a T > 0 request that asks for logprobs uses MRV2's rejection sampler instead of the keyed draws (same distribution, different sample); every MRV2 boot logs this.

Rebase note: `main`'s `build_attn_metadata` has no `ubatch_id`, so the V4.1 `prepare_attn` does not take or pass one (our older base did; passing it on `main` is a `TypeError` on every forward, which `test_prepare_attn_matches_default_plus_prefill_flag` catches).

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check
python -m tools.config_inventory --check
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_metadata.py
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_registration.py
python -m tools.generate_architecture_reference --check
# plain, then with the Triton kernels in the interpreter (on before triton is imported):
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_mrv2_v41.py tests/v1/worker/test_mrv2_v41_dummy_positions.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_mrv2_dspark_context_buckets.py
TRITON_INTERPRET=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q <the same three files>
# runner regression, this branch vs #1377 alone:
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner.py tests/v1/sample/test_rejection_sampler.py \
  tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dspark.py tests/config/test_runtime_default_ownership.py
```

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| V4.1 model state | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`, `model_type` deepseek_v41 | `DeepseekV41ModelState`; other models keep the default state | CPU tests (state selection, prepare_attn vs default, PP restore on every stage, commit order, async-scheduler model); measured on 8x V100 | GPU rounding not covered by the CPU tests |
| V4.1 DSpark speculator | DeepSeek-V4.1 + DSpark | MRV2 on, DSpark draft model | V4.1 speculator; other drafters keep #1221's speculator | CPU tests of draft-sampling order and fallbacks; measured on 8x V100 | same |
| Dummy positions | all MRV2 models | dummy / profile / capture batches | `CHAIN` for V4.1, `ZEROS` otherwise | CPU test through the real capture inputs and hash kernels (Triton interpreter); boot on 8x V100 | — |
| MRV2 off | all | default | unchanged V1 runner | CPU tests of the touched files, same failing names as #1377 | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: opt-in; `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER` defaults off.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: #1370 PP2 x TP4 profile, DSpark drafter, `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: the #1277 packed-KV default.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port and our other default-off levers; this branch is the MRV2 change on #1370 + #1375 + #1377 + #1221, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: none.
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: below.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: unchanged; each speculator fallback logs its reason once.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no variable renamed or removed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: no new variables; env, config-inventory and architecture references pass.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: unchanged.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-04,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, DeepSeek-V4.1 PP2 x TP4, DSpark, one request, paired MRV2-on vs MRV2-off arms on the same build:

- Decode, ms per verify round (on - off): -2.759 ms (95 % interval -2.898 to -2.620). Output tokens identical (bitwise) at T=0.
- Throughput, tok/s, two runs each: T=0, V1 120.5 / 120.2 vs MRV2 134.2 / 135.0; T=1, V1 121.8 / 122.0 vs MRV2 136.6 / 136.4.
- Context-depth sweep, ms per round, MRV2 - V1, two runs: 2K -2.59 / -2.87; 8K -2.78 / -2.85; 16K -2.67 / -2.67; **32K +1.41 / +1.44 (MRV2 slower)**; 64K -2.70 / -2.94. At 150K, 26.65 vs 30.02 ms per round. The 32K regression is reproducible and its cause is not yet known; we are tracing MRV2's per-step work at that depth and will report it here.
- 150K-token prompt, first token: about 83 s with #1376's prefill skip under MRV2, vs 105.5 s without the skip.

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** CPU only (no visible GPU), on this branch rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`:

- pytest `test_mrv2_v41.py`, `test_mrv2_v41_dummy_positions.py`, `test_mrv2_dspark_context_buckets.py`: 46 passed, 14 skipped (Triton kernel cases); with `TRITON_INTERPRET=1`, 60 passed.
- Runner regression (`test_gpu_model_runner.py`, `test_rejection_sampler.py`, `test_dspark.py`, `test_runtime_default_ownership.py`): 41 passed, 2 skipped, 115 failed, 17 errors on both this branch and #1377 alone, with identical failing names (no CUDA device visible). Nothing new fails.
- `generate_env_reference --check`, `config_inventory --check`, `check_env_metadata.py`, `check_env_registration.py`, `generate_architecture_reference --check`: all pass.
- ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check` on the changed Python files: pass.

Not re-run: any GPU test, boot or serving on this branch; the numbers above were not re-measured on it.

---
